description: Per-container resource use from cAdvisor. Only VM 310's own containers report today: the VM 300 agent scrape list is intentionally empty until Observability Stage I-G installs the agents, so VM 300's nine containers are absent by design, not missing.

panels.description: Working set per container - the memory actually in use, excluding reclaimable page cache. Every container in this lab has a hard memory limit, so a flat line pressed against a round number is a container at its ceiling.
